name: sovereign-fim
description: Ghost-text code completion served by your local svrn daemon — no cloud, no account, full glassbox.

commands.title: Sovereign: Show call sites of the signature being edited

sovereign-fim.endpoint.description: Base URL of the local Sovereign daemon.

sovereign-fim.debounceMs.description: Keystroke debounce before requesting a completion.

sovereign-fim.maxPrefixLines.description: Lines before the cursor sent as FIM prefix.

sovereign-fim.maxSuffixLines.description: Lines after the cursor sent as FIM suffix.

sovereign-fim.nextEdit.enable.description: Watch edits and suggest the next repeated edit (Tab to accept) when the daemon's confidence threshold is met.

sovereign-fim.nextEdit.settleMs.description: Idle time after a burst of edits before the edit unit closes and the daemon is consulted.

sovereign-fim.nextEdit.modelLane.description: Consult the editing model for repeated multi-line inserts when the rule engine declines. Needs no coder model — next-edit rides any chat model's prompt surface — so this is silently inert only when the daemon has no editing model at all. Scope narrowed 2026-08-06: on the 1,098-case golden set the other two consult shapes (fan-out insert, per-site-varying rewrite) were wrong far more often than right, so they are now detected and declined — keeping them cost 23 wrong suggestions to buy 4 good ones. The earlier 30/30 result came from a bank that only contained shapes the gate already admitted.

sovereign-fim.disabledLanguages.description: Language ids where completions are not offered.

sovereign-fim.nextEdit.symbolLane.description: Show a jump list of call sites when you edit a function's parameter list. Requires an indexed corpus for the workspace. Proposes no edits.

sovereign-fim.nextEdit.corpusId.description: Indexed corpus describing this workspace, for the call-site jump list. Empty means the workspace folder's name.
